game.name: Binary Domain (Germany)(En,De)
game.desc: Binary Domain is an action game for Xbox 360 set in a futuristic Tokyo. In 2080, the world's major powers discover that human-like robots have infiltrated the entire society. The existence of this type of android goes against the new Geneva Convention. An IRTA squad is therefore tasked with investigating the Amada company, which is suspected of having designed these robots.
